title: oss-docs project layer
description: A project's content & brand: src/_data/project.json in its site directory. Settings (flavor, site, studio) live in package.json under `oss-docs`; name, license, repository, & links are derived from package.json.

accent.description: A hex color such as #2346d4. The text-safe shade & on-accent color derive from it in CSS.

tagline.description: Defaults to the first sentence of the package.json description.

lede.description: Hero paragraph; defaults to the package.json description.

install.description: Install command; defaults to `npm install <package name>`.

usage.description: One copy-pasteable code sample under Usage.

features.description: Feature cards: three to six, each leading with what the project does for the reader.

logo.description: The project's wordmark: a file in src/assets/img/. Without it the header shows the name.

favicon.description: A file in src/assets/img/. Without it the page has no icon link.

fonts.description: Font overrides for sans & display. Mono is locked to PT Mono.

flavor.description: A site setting: set it in package.json under `oss-docs`.

site.description: A site setting: set it in package.json under `oss-docs`.

studio.description: A site setting: set it in package.json under `oss-docs`.
